register.disposition_and_reason: Ellis Harnett is settlor. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell must exercise income and capital discretion jointly. Clause 4 gives neither object a payment entitlement before an appointment in that object's favour. Neither Ione's letter nor EX-K4 is such an appointment. Clause 6 separately permits a unanimous addition of a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee, without settlor consent, effective on joint delivery as a deed. The common custody procedure can identify this parent by PD-6834-R. It was not the parent used for SD-Q7M2. England and Wales law applies.
register.adviser_check: Check the full deed, omitted schedule and any later additions or removals. Is there a joint decision already recorded? If so, identify its reference, object, amount, payee, purpose and conditions and reconcile it to Alder Quay's payment record before a new decision.

register.matter: Flint Orchard Settlement — second decision paper

register.disposition_and_reason: Cora Teague is settlor. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell act together over income and capital; they may apply funds directly for an Object's benefit. source_audit.finding: Maren Dovell's 12 June note reports the appointments book for both named people and trusts. It alone supports four current trustee edges and supplies the continuity component of the alternatives. The underlying book is not separately reproduced. The booking, brief and instruction to prepare minutes neither identify objects nor authorise payments.

Tess Arnay's 9 June certified extract of the 21 October 2022 Alder Quay deed independently supports one settlor and two continuing objects. It identifies the original trustees for the continuity routes, the joint power, addition procedure and PD-6834-R. The certificate and copied clauses have one deed origin. The schedule is omitted; no later addition or payment decision is reported here.

Bram Lerrit's 9 June certified extract of the 21 October 2022 Flint Orchard deed independently supports one settlor and two continuing Objects. The original trustee field supports continuity. The parent identity, exclusions and clause 8 delivery procedure are necessary parts of the later addition analysis. The extract omits schedules, does not name Rhea and does not exercise the clause 5 power.

Checked transcript of the trustees' signed SD-Q7M2, not a draft or a second designation. It proves the living individual's designation, unique reference, witnessed execution and addition-only terms. Della Pennick witnessed each signature; Alys Morcant checked the paper on 26 March before handover and expressly did not attest delivery. The transcript cannot alone identify the parent or prove effectiveness.

Gideon Sarn certified one live entry on 11 June. Its origin was his first-hand observation at the 26 March handover, independent of the transcript for the delivery fact. It establishes one original, immediate joint delivery and the exact reference pair, not a beneficiary name. The extract and underlying entry are not independent deliveries or independent accounts of designation. The unreadable-character convention has no application to either actual field.

First-person evidence of Ione's request, estimate problem and limited permission, not independent evidence of either of her beneficiary edges. The letter addresses two people but does not identify a trust office for either, add Sella, confer a general agency or establish kinship.

Una Cresset reports the claim, slip, missing print voucher and account match. The report is held; the underlying operating-account line is not a second supplied report. The EX-K4 remit is limited, neither item was recharged and there is no distribution instruction for the claim. No scored edge follows. For all seven Sources, inclusion in the closed file establishes availability by cut-off, not a precise receipt time inferred from execution, matching or certification.
